status: FROZEN_PROPOSAL (Phase 1). Freeze = the commit that adds this file; it must precede the first Phase 3 S-test run. Any change after that is a new version (surface_protocol_v2) with the reason recorded.

source.basis: Analytic expectations (tech review section 7.2), the G1/G2 geometric controls and the G3a/G3b repeat spread. No threshold is fitted to a cut result of the method under test (cut_aware_surface_v1 does not exist yet).

resolution.note: All thresholds are in particle spacings s; at another spacing they scale with s, but a new resolution needs its own G1/G2 controls before use.

profiles_compared.baseline_A: particle_surface_v1 = CuttingSurface profile current_volume_v1 (the profile every configured/registered task renders; legacy reported alongside, never the comparison target)

metrics.region_rule: region_rule_v1: a vertex is cut-face if its nearest same-component boundary sample is a cut side sample within 1.5 s; core = cut-face vertices >= 3 s from every exterior sample of their component
metrics.distance: P50/P95/max over cut-face vertices, absolute signed distance to the local least-squares plane of same (component, cut, side) locus samples within the patch radius; plus the reverse locus->mesh exact point-triangle distance and coverage (fraction of locus samples within 1 s of the mesh)
metrics.signed_error: bias_toward_side2 = mean offset of both faces along N (side 1 -> 2); thickness_bias = mean(side-1 offset) - mean(side-2 offset)
metrics.normal_error: core cut-face triangles vs the fitted local locus plane normal (radius 3 mm), unsigned; outward fraction reported; the F-mapped (Nanson) normal is a secondary diagnostic
metrics.roughness: patch plane-fit RMS (radius 2 mm), quadratic mean and P50/P95, mesh core vs locus core; never a success criterion on its own
metrics.mesh_validity: degenerate, boundary, non-manifold, inconsistently oriented edges; shells; per-shell signed volume > 0 and Euler characteristic; bounded self-intersection sample (20000 triangles)
metrics.boundary_continuity: rim corner samples x_e + F_e (P - X_e + s/2 d) -> mesh distance P95/max; open edges within 2 s of a corner
metrics.topology: shells per mechanical component from the extractor's provenance; shells built from > 1 component; components without shell; faces nearer another component (visual interpenetration)
metrics.volume: mesh vs sum m/rho (reference) and sum (m/rho) det F (current), total and per component
metrics.detached_mass_and_bridges: mechanical_components_packed masses; law8_validation.bridge_report per digit; code-0 particles lattice-adjacent to both sides
metrics.temporal: frames without code change: topology hash and vertex residual vs the embedding function; slow motion: residual after transporting the previous mesh by its nearest particles' displacement (temporal_stability)

references_and_spaces.material_reference_space: Hermite points P and normals N of cut_events_v1 (exact solver decision); local plane of P within the patch radius. For B: its pre-embedding mesh. For A: approximate pull-back X = X_p + F_p^-1 (v - x_p), diagnostic only.
references_and_spaces.current_space: side locus q = x_p + F_p (P - X_p) of the same (component, cut, side), local plane; translation-only q and the raw face particles reported alongside (Phase 1: F mapping adds up to ~0.02 mm RMS under the wedge strain)
references_and_spaces.fallback: link_midpoint_fallback (no recorder): clearly labelled; staircase-limited thresholds below; never presented as recorder quality
references_and_spaces.never: the declared/target cut plane is never a reference for B or A (G2 analytic plane only in the geometric unit test); post-cut physical deformation is reported as material behaviour, never as surface error

expected_discretization_error_from_phase.midpoint_locus_staircase_oblique: P95 0.40 s, max 0.43 s, RMS 0.22 s (G2 30 deg and (1,2,3)/sqrt14); 0 on lattice-aligned planes through cell faces; constant offset up to 0.5 s for an axis plane between cell faces (G2 axis_x 0.30 s)
expected_discretization_error_from_phase.A_current_volume_v1_zero_physics: core P95 vs analytic plane 0.14-0.30 s (dominated by the staircase); vs its own midpoint locus 0.07-0.09 s; normal P50 4.1-4.6 deg / P95 8-12 deg on oblique planes; rim corner P95 0.9-1.25 s; volume -1.8 to -2.3 %
expected_discretization_error_from_phase.A_legacy_zero_physics: thickness bias +1.02 to +1.20 s (each face ~0.6 s outward), volume +17 to +20 %
expected_discretization_error_from_phase.B_expected: tech review section 7.2: P95 <= 0.05 s, max <= 0.25 s with recorder Hermite data in the reference space

measurement_uncertainty.phase1_repeat_spread: G3a and G3b repeats (same seed, cuda:1): every reported current-space distance/roughness P95 within 0.005 s between repeats; codes, recorder audits and verdicts identical
measurement_uncertainty.rule: A comparison B vs A is decided only when the difference exceeds 0.06 s (or 1 deg for normals, 0.5 % for volume); S-tests run >= 2 repeats and report the spread

S2_deformed_cut.report: embedding estimator and det F fallback counts

S3_curved_trajectory.report: single-plane residual (must not be forced to 0)

S8_recontact.report: inter-shell intersections, particle gap and penetration from contact stats

all.temporal_fixed_state: topology hash constant and vertex residual <= 1e-3 s

phase3_comparison_gate.rule: B is not worse than A on any frozen metric beyond the measurement uncertainty, and B is better than A on cut-face current-space P95 distance, coverage (partial cuts, chips) and topology (shells = components, no skipped fragments)

A_reference_values_phase1.coverage: 0.89-1.00 separated faces; 0.26 partial cut (G4); 0.37 thin chip (G5, chip skipped)

S_test_definitions.S1: physical flat cut: G3a (registered CUT-01-R scripted edge, kinematic_env, seed 42) and G3b (drive_blade, 80x30x12 mm block, vertical cut yawed 20 deg)
S_test_definitions.S2: compress then cut: drive_blade, flat press 2 mm (disarmed) then vertical cut through the compressed zone (new in Phase 3)
S_test_definitions.S3: curved trajectory: a vertical cut whose edge yaws by >= 15 deg during the stroke (drive_blade_sequence with per-substep rotation or a sequence of short yawed phases; new in Phase 3)
S_test_definitions.S4: partial cut: G4 (6 of 12 mm, hold armed, withdraw disarmed)
S_test_definitions.S5: intersecting cuts: G6 (two parallel + one perpendicular, slots_per_node 16)
S_test_definitions.S6: four parallel slices: blade_probe slices5-like 4-cut plan on a 120 mm walled block (probe_v5_multicut slices) with the recorder
S_test_definitions.S7: thin chip: G5 (dome 4 mm, edge 2 mm above the substrate, rake 25 deg)
S_test_definitions.S8: recontact: G7 (cut, disarmed side push closing the kerf, hold, withdraw)
S_test_definitions.S9: negative controls: G8 (armed approach, armed flat press, armed side push, disarmed slide, disarmed plunge) and the G4 hold phase
S_test_definitions.runner_parameters: scripts/run_wp12_phase1_geometry.py PROTOCOL (1 mm, 4 mm grid, 0.1 ms, law 8, tlmpm_v5, ruler_knife_v1, cutting_energy 5 J/m^2, recorder on)
